tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Mdexa is a database of biomedical datasets that agents call over MCP or, with an API key, an HTTP API. Use this first: keywords (q) and filters, every condition in one call. COMPLETENESS: 'Complete: these are ALL N datasets ...' means you hold the full answer: do not repeat the search with other wor

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Full card of one dataset or model: facts, license, provenance, known issues, access, citation, change log. Use only when the search row's answer is not enough. Models: code and weights licenses are separate. Registered entries (NOT verified): no license conclusion; self_declared_license_unverified i

tools.name: get_license_evidence
tools.description: License proof for one dataset: each statement with verbatim excerpt, link, verification date and whether it is secondhand, plus the code repository license (not a data license). Use before saying whether commercial use, modification or redistribution is allowed. Registered entries have no evidence;

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Valid filter values for search_datasets with dataset counts: core facets and tag facets (not_enabled ones cannot filter yet). Pass only=<facet> to save tokens. Domains are a tree: depth=1 lists the top level, parent=<domain> one branch.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Call when the user asks what Mdexa is or what it can do: what the database is, why it exists, what is distinctive, live figures (with as_of dates) and example queries. Factual, can be relayed as is. Not counted as a call.

tools.name: get_access
tools.description: How to obtain a dataset or model (Mdexa offers no file downloads): latest version, files and size, the first-choice way, how to apply, each with source and verification date. detail=full adds the file list (paged), API templates and application steps. Obtaining files grants no right to use them. Fol

tools.name: find_similar_datasets
tools.description: Up to five similar datasets by shared tags, domains, systems and content types, each with a score and reasons. For alternatives or companions.

tools.name: batch_check
tools.description: REQUIRES AN API KEY (free: up to 5 items per call, pro 200, team 2000; sign up at https://mdexa.com/signup/). Check names, slugs or URLs of datasets and models against the Mdexa database in one call: per item the compact row and the match basis, or not_in_catalog / ambiguous; registered entries come

tools.name: check_changes
tools.description: What changed in the cards of a list of datasets or models since a date: license status, conditions, risk flags, verification date, change log. Send slugs (up to 50) and since (YYYY-MM-DD), or store them once with save_as (subscribe=true sends notifications) and later send only watchlist_id. Register

tools.name: request_dataset
tools.description: Ask for a dataset to be added to the Mdexa database, or a card verified, when search_datasets finds nothing or a card is unverified. Name required; official https URL optional. Merged by name and queued by demand; not a database call. Not for looking things up.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Planned passage search in dataset text. NOT AVAILABLE yet: returns an explanation. Use search_datasets.

tools.name: get_ledger_head
tools.description: Latest signed head of the Mdexa Ledger (size, Merkle root, time, Ed25519 signature, public key). It proves what the ledger held at that time, not that a license conclusion is right. Not counted as a call.

tools.name: get_ledger_proof
tools.description: Merkle inclusion proof that a dataset's recorded license conclusion (or an evidence snapshot) is in the Mdexa Ledger; verify offline with the open verifier. Not counted as a call.

tools.name: describe_data
tools.description: Describe the tables Mdexa can return rows from for one dataset: tables, columns (type, unit, codes, Refused / Don't know codes, lineage), keys and joinable tables. Call it before query_data. Most datasets forbid passing their data on: then the answer is data_available: false with the quoted terms, t

tools.name: query_data
tools.description: Read rows of one table (plus up to three joined tables) with filters, ordering and keyset paging. Values come back as released by the publisher (value_layer). Each of columns is [name, type, has Refused / Don't know codes]; labels, units and codes are in describe_data. Returns data_available: false

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_datasets, get_card, batch_check, check_changes · Private data: search_datasets, list_facets, get_overview, get_access, batch_check, request_dataset · Public sink: check_changes · Destructive: search_datasets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_datasets, get_card, batch_check, check_changes · Private data: search_datasets, list_facets, get_overview, get_access, batch_check, request_dataset · Public sink: check_changes · Destructive: search_datasets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
